# Carthagent local dashboard API

Version 1.1.2. OpenAPI source: [dashboard.openapi.json](dashboard.openapi.json).

Local HTTP API served by server.mjs (`npm start`) for the browser dashboard.

The dashboard binds to 127.0.0.1 only, on `CARTHAGENT_PORT` (default 3000; 0 picks an ephemeral port). It operates on the workspace in `CARTHAGENT_WORKSPACE` (default: the current directory) and persists delivery state as report files under that workspace. Every `/api/*` request must send the session token in the `x-carthagent-token` header; the token is `CARTHAGENT_SERVER_TOKEN` when set, otherwise a random value printed once in the startup URL (`/?token=...`). Requests that send an `Origin` header must come from the dashboard origin itself. Request bodies are JSON (`express.json`, 1 MB limit); malformed JSON or oversize bodies are rejected by Express before reaching a handler (400/413). All `/api/*` responses carry `cache-control: no-store`. Mutating endpoints (`/api/design`, `/api/plan/set`, `/api/plan/revise`, `/api/checks/run`, `/api/review`, `/api/finish`) first take a cross-process workspace lease and answer 409 when it is unavailable. Non-API GET requests serve the static dashboard from `public/` and fall back to `public/index.html`; they are not part of this API.

Servers: `http://127.0.0.1:{port}`.

## Authentication

- `dashboardToken` (header `x-carthagent-token`): Dashboard session token: `CARTHAGENT_SERVER_TOKEN`, or the random token printed in the startup URL. Compared in constant time.

| Method | Path | Summary |

<a id="op-getstatus"></a>

### GET `/api/status`

Read the active delivery state.

Reloads the newest report for the workspace (unless checks are running), fingerprints the workspace and returns the plan, evidence, pending checks and planning gate.

Operation ID: `getStatus`. Auth: `dashboardToken`

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Current delivery state. | application/json: [Status](#schema-status) |
| 401 | Missing or wrong `x-carthagent-token` header. Body is `{"error":"Unauthorized"}`. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The request carried an `Origin` header other than `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` or `http://localhost:<port>`. Body is `{"error":"Origin not allowed"}`. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 500 | Reading or fingerprinting the workspace failed. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |

<a id="op-setplan"></a>

### POST `/api/plan/set`

Start a delivery with a new plan, or replace the active plan.

Verification defaults to `required`. When a plan is active and not finished, harness-required checks (`required_*`) are re-bound and the change is recorded as a revision; otherwise a new run and report are created. The report becomes the selected workspace report.

Operation ID: `setPlan`. Auth: `dashboardToken`

Takes the cross-process workspace lease; answers 409 when another process holds it.

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plan` | [Plan](#schema-plan) | yes |  |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Plan saved. | application/json: {`success`, `plan`, `d2`, `report`} |
| 400 | The plan or revision is invalid. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 401 | Missing or wrong `x-carthagent-token` header. Body is `{"error":"Unauthorized"}`. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The request carried an `Origin` header other than `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` or `http://localhost:<port>`. Body is `{"error":"Origin not allowed"}`. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 409 | Another process holds the workspace lease (for example a concurrent `ctg check`), or checks are running or queued. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |

<a id="op-bindrequiredchecks"></a>

### POST `/api/plan/bind-required`

Bind harness-required checks into a plan and validate it.

Pure function: nothing is saved. Required checks replace same-ID checks, force `verification: required` and add one `[Harness required] <id>` acceptance item each.

Operation ID: `bindRequiredChecks`. Auth: `dashboardToken`

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plan` | [Plan](#schema-plan) | yes |  |
| `required` | array of [Check](#schema-check) | yes |  |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Bound and validated plan. | application/json: {`success`, `plan`, `d2`} |
| 400 | The plan or the required checks are invalid. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 401 | Missing or wrong `x-carthagent-token` header. Body is `{"error":"Unauthorized"}`. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The request carried an `Origin` header other than `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` or `http://localhost:<port>`. Body is `{"error":"Origin not allowed"}`. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |

<a id="op-designaction"></a>

### POST `/api/design`

Run a design-gate action on the active plan.

Implementation is locked until the current plan revision has been validated, inspected, reviewed and approved on the current source fingerprint. For `review`, the review fields may be sent inside `review` or at the top level; `review.id` is accepted as `captureId`.

Operation ID: `designAction`. Auth: `dashboardToken`

Takes the cross-process workspace lease; answers 409 when another process holds it.

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | `"validate"`, `"inspect"`, `"review"`, `"approve"` | yes |  |
| `review` | [DesignReview](#schema-designreview) | no |  |
| `captureId` | string | no |  |
| `challenges` | array of any | no |  |
| `walkthroughs` | array of any | no |  |
| `findings` | array of any | no |  |
| `limitations` | array of any | no |  |
| `resolutions` | array of any | no |  |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Action applied and persisted. | application/json: {`result`, `planningStatus`} |
| 400 | No active plan, unknown action, or the action was rejected. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 401 | Missing or wrong `x-carthagent-token` header. Body is `{"error":"Unauthorized"}`. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The request carried an `Origin` header other than `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` or `http://localhost:<port>`. Body is `{"error":"Origin not allowed"}`. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 409 | Another process holds the workspace lease (for example a concurrent `ctg check`), or checks are running or queued. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |

<a id="op-runchecks"></a>

### POST `/api/checks/run`

Run one or all plan checks and record evidence.

Requires an approved design (implementation must be unlocked). Checks run serially in the workspace without a shell; each result records exit code, timing, output tail, a log path and whether the workspace changed while the check ran. A check passes only when it exits 0, did not time out, was not cancelled, stayed within the output limit and left the workspace fingerprint unchanged.

Operation ID: `runChecks`. Auth: `dashboardToken`

Takes the cross-process workspace lease; answers 409 when another process holds it.

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | A check ID from the plan, or `all`. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Checks executed (individual checks may have failed; see `passed`). | application/json: {`results`, `pendingChecks`, `currentFingerprint`} |
| 400 | No active plan, or the plan has no checks. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 401 | Missing or wrong `x-carthagent-token` header. Body is `{"error":"Unauthorized"}`. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The request carried an `Origin` header other than `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` or `http://localhost:<port>`. Body is `{"error":"Origin not allowed"}`. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 404 | `id` does not name a check in the plan. Body is `{"error":"Unknown check ID: <id>"}`. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 409 | Another process holds the workspace lease (for example a concurrent `ctg check`), or checks are running or queued. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 500 | Implementation is still locked by the design gate, or running the checks failed. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |

<a id="op-deliveryreview"></a>

### POST `/api/review`

Capture or record the delivery review.

`inspect` captures the Git diff (or a no-repository notice) for review. `record` stores the review against that capture; all checks must be fresh.

Operation ID: `deliveryReview`. Auth: `dashboardToken`

Takes the cross-process workspace lease; answers 409 when another process holds it.

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`.

Schema: [DeliveryReviewRequest](#schema-deliveryreviewrequest)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | `"inspect"`, `"record"` | yes |  |
| `captureId` | string | no | Required for record: ID of the latest inspect capture. |
| `coverage` | array of object | no |  |
| `probes` | array of string | no | Boundary or metamorphic probes with observed results. (min items `1`) |
| `findings` | array of string | no | Open defects; empty when none. |
| `limitations` | array of string | no |  |
| `outcomes` | array of object | no |  |
| `resolutions` | array of object | no |  |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Review action applied. | application/json: {`success`, `result`} |
| 400 | No active plan, unknown action, stale capture, or malformed review record. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 401 | Missing or wrong `x-carthagent-token` header. Body is `{"error":"Unauthorized"}`. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The request carried an `Origin` header other than `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` or `http://localhost:<port>`. Body is `{"error":"Origin not allowed"}`. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 409 | Another process holds the workspace lease (for example a concurrent `ctg check`), or checks are running or queued. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |

<a id="op-finishdelivery"></a>

### POST `/api/finish`

Finish the delivery as verified or blocked.

`verified` requires every completion issue to be resolved (fresh passing evidence and review). `blocked` requires at least one limitation explaining why.

Operation ID: `finishDelivery`. Auth: `dashboardToken`

Takes the cross-process workspace lease; answers 409 when another process holds it.

**Request body** (required)

Content type `application/json`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `"verified"`, `"blocked"` | yes |  |
| `review` | string | no |  |
| `launch` | string | no | How to launch or use the result. |
| `limitations` | array of string | no |  |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Delivery finished; the handoff is recorded in `state.handoff`. | application/json: {`success`, `state`} |
| 400 | Invalid status, no active plan, outstanding completion issues, or a blocked handoff without limitations. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 401 | Missing or wrong `x-carthagent-token` header. Body is `{"error":"Unauthorized"}`. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 403 | The request carried an `Origin` header other than `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` or `http://localhost:<port>`. Body is `{"error":"Origin not allowed"}`. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |
| 409 | Another process holds the workspace lease (for example a concurrent `ctg check`), or checks are running or queued. | application/json: [Error](#schema-error) |

<a id="schema-check"></a>

### Check

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | Unique safe identifier (`^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,39}$`, not `all`). Harness-required checks use the `required_` prefix. (pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,39}$`) |
| `kind` | `"test"`, `"runtime"`, `"static"` | yes |  |

### Step

| `kind` | `"work"`, `"regression"` | no |  |

<a id="schema-plan"></a>

### Plan

Delivery plan. `required` verification needs acceptance criteria and at least one test or runtime check; every acceptance item must reference existing check IDs.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `goal` | string | yes |  (min length `1`) |
| `assumptions` | array of string | no |  |
| `artifacts` | array of string | yes | Relative artifact roots that exist at completion (for example `.` or `src`). (min items `1`) |
| `outputs` | array of string | no | Relative paths of produced evidence. |
| `steps` | array of string or [Step](#schema-step) | yes | 1 to 40 steps; strings are legacy sequential labels. (min items `1`, max items `40`) |
| `verification` | `"required"`, `"advisory"`, `"none"` | no |  (default `required`) |
| `acceptance` | array of [Acceptance](#schema-acceptance) | no |  |
| `checks` | array of [Check](#schema-check) | no |  |
| `design` | object | no | Tested design record used by the design gate. |
| `workflow` | object | no | Optional explicit workflow graph. |
| `outcomes` | array of object | no | Outcome obligations with linked checks. |
